title: SCHC draft omits required terminal tombstone and late-fragment semantics
description: Correctness review: spec/03-adaptation.md:313-330 normatively requires a 60-second terminal/expiry tombstone retaining replay high-water, outcome, and cached final ACK where applicable, and restricts session restart. draft-lichen-schc-lora-00.md:369-371 instead says inactivity sends Receiver-Abort and releases state; lines 500-505 say abort releases retained packet/reassembly state, but the draft never defines tombstones/high-water/restart gates despite referring to terminal hold-down at line 360. An implementer following the I-D can free all key state and let late authenticated fragments create a new T=0 session. Mirror or normatively reference the complete tombstone rules in the draft and distinguish active-buffer release from tombstone retention.
